Audio plugins by ITMR Audio.

ITMR Audio develops vocal-processing and creative-effects plugins for independent artists and music producers. Explore the interfaces and join the early-access list for release news.

ARC VOX vocal processing plugin

Build a vocal chain with cleanup, pitch correction, de-essing, compression, six-band parametric EQ, color and space. Learn Voice establishes a starting point; CONTROL and CHARACTER shape the result.

ARC FX creative multi-effects plugin

Explore 17 effects in a reorderable pedal rack. FLUX controls transformation and ROAM controls movement, with serial, parallel and mid/side routing for sound design.
